attribution_scope.target: hash-bound checkpoint reconstructed on CPU and evaluated on each fixed true-class probe batch
attribution_scope.limitation: the attribution result describes the deterministic CPU/class-batch reconstruction and is not a numerical explanation of archived GPU score arrays or an alternative full-probe batch shape

score_target_fidelity.note: same-batch deployed CPU scorer versus exact-forward wrapper; all rows are audited before attribution begins
